scope: Numerical results explicitly listed in this publication catalogue. General families and structural theorems are indexed in README.md; their infinitely many specialisations are not enumerated.

semantics.relation: = means an exact value with attainment; >= means a proved lower bound.
semantics.first_release: First release of this precise statement in this project, not historical mathematical priority. Prepared releases have no confirmed public date.
semantics.derivation: Named method, proved seed and every intermediate ceiling. These support ablation analysis but do not assert that a method or dependency is mathematically necessary.
semantics.comparison: Dated catalogue observations, separate from proof premises. Null means not recorded here, not equal or unknown in the literature. No current-best or priority claim.
semantics.lean: Declarations and their selected source files; numerical substitutions and arithmetic checks are documentation checks, not new Lean compilation.

records.method: Rank equality and actual block supports
